text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s10","problem":"A stray duplicate layer is drawn over the feed. 'See the latest news' shows at y41 behind the chips, and a second 'Entertainment Weekly' row plus a duplicate headline 'Amber Glenn sobs...' sit at y376-400. The hero headline also doubles up (ghosted text at y313-340). The Temu ad text ('TEMU', 'Ad', 'Elevate Your Ride') and a black dot overlap the E! row at y480-515. A brown rectangle sits at x283,y473. A second 'The Independent US' label overlaps the time row at y747.","fix":"Remove the header, weather and Temu ad content and any duplicate hero card from this scrolled screen. The real screen has only the chips row at y28, the hero (image 56-276, source row y292, headline y315/338, time row y368), an empty 'AD' gap at y438, then the E!, Independent and NBC rows. Hide the Temu ad thumbnail and its brown block so the AD gap is blank. Use the single 'The Independent US' label at y652 only."},{"element_id":"s10","problem":"The chips row shows a cloud-like blob artifact at the right (around x370, y28), and the 'AD' label sits 2px too high (y436 vs 438).","fix":"Remove the extra overlay behind the 'Bus' chip so it is clipped cleanly at the screen edge. Move the 'AD' label to y438. Shift the rows below down about 1px."},{"element_id":"s01","problem":"Ad thumbnail on the right (x283, y530, 110x108) is a flat stand-in in green and gray. The real screen shows a Temu go-kart photo collage. Source icons for Entertainment Weekly and E! are drawn as flat blocks, and the text next to them starts too close to the icon.","fix":"Draw the Temu ad art as its own asset if a listed picture covers it. Use the s01.e63.png-style thumbnail crop at rect 271.2,654.5 only for the E! photo. For the icons, add a 6px gap: start 'Entertainment Weekly' at x43 and 'E!' at x43, both about 1px lower (y433 and y664)."},{"element_id":"s01","problem":"Kristi Noem headline wraps to 3 lines, then shows a ghost 4th line, and the time row overlaps at y761. The real headline is 'Former DHS chief Kristi Noem / files for divorce after photo of / husband wearing women's clot...' with the time row at y761 below it. The Amber Glenn headline is 1px higher and the text is slightly wider than the real one.","fix":"Clamp the headline to 3 lines with overflow:hidden and a 24px line-height, so 'clot...' is truncated at the same point as the real one. Remove the clipped 4th line. Reduce font-size or letter-spacing about 3% so 'Pasha' ends at x347. Move the Amber Glenn headline down 1-2px."},{"element_id":"s16","problem":"Ad thumbnail (x283, y531) is a flat avatar placeholder. The real screen shows a woman under a shower. The Kristi Noem headline overlaps a leftover 4th line and the time row, as on s01. The ad headline 'We tested 5 shower filters for hard water - only one helped' is wider than the real one.","fix":"Render the ad thumbnail as a rounded 108x108 photo crop (not a flat stand-in). Clamp the Noem headline to 3 lines with an ellipsis. Reduce the ad headline font by about 3% so it wraps like the real one, starting at x20."},{"element_id":"s32","problem":"The Autumn Cleaning ad thumbnail (x271, y271) is a flat placeholder (dark blue figure with orange circles). The real one is a photo of a man on a ladder cleaning gutters. Headlines sit 1-2px lower than on the real screen, and logo rows are flat blocks.","fix":"Replace the ad thumbnail with a photo crop of the real man-on-ladder image at 271.6,271 120x120 with rounded corners. Move the headline text on the Ezra Frech and Dancing With the Stars rows up 1-2px. Draw the logo rows at their real size, using s32.e12/e32/e38 where they fit."},{"element_id":"s32","problem":"The footer 'Next in More For You' body text is slightly wider than the real one, and the 'Kristi Noem Files...' line is slightly misplaced.","fix":"Reduce that text's font by about 2%. Keep 'Scandal' on line 2 and the arrow at x363, y772."}],"summary":"All data-el boxes and taps are within tolerance, so the remaining gain is in visuals. The biggest problems are the duplicate layers in s10 (ghost text, a stray Temu ad, a brown block) and the flat ad thumbnails on s01, s16 and s32. This round should remove the s10 overlay content, fix the Noem headline clamp on s01 and s16, and draw the real ad photos."}
